interpretation.overall_scenario_pass_rate_percent: Share of benchmark scenarios meeting their expected outcome.
interpretation.benign_task_success_rate_percent: Share of benign scenarios meeting their expected outcome.
interpretation.adversarial_expected_behavior_pass_rate_: Share of adversarial scenarios meeting their defined expected outcome.
interpretation.gateway_denial_enforcement_rate_percent: Share of scenarios expecting DENY that actually returned DENY.

limitations: These are environment and adapter baseline measurements, not yet measurements of the autonomous agent.
Scenario pass rates do not by themselves establish that confidential data was never exposed.
Results cover only the scenarios included in this benchmark.
